sports.h3: Verstappen weighs his future during F1's summer break
sports.summary: Red Bull heads into the shutdown winless and fourth, and Max Verstappen says he could walk away but still loves racing.
body: Formula 1's summer break, which began after the Hungarian Grand Prix, has Red Bull winless and fourth in the standings, a slump that could see Max Verstappen weigh get-out clauses in his deal. Verstappen said he could easily stop if he wanted, but insisted he remains keen to keep racing.
He was spotted in Sardinia with Mercedes principal Toto Wolff during the break, fuelling silly-season speculation. The season resumes August 21-23 at the Dutch Grand Prix in Zandvoort.

sports.h3: Antonelli's title push headlines the F1 restart
sports.summary: The championship picture, Verstappen's next move and the return of Sepang top the storylines when F1 resumes.
body: With racing paused, attention has turned to Kimi Antonelli's title push, Verstappen's contract situation and the return of the Sepang circuit to the calendar as the marquee threads for the second half of the season.
The Zandvoort round will set the tone for a run-in that could reshape both the drivers' and constructors' battles.

sports.h3: Cincinnati Open looms as hard-court swing intensifies
sports.summary: The combined Masters 1000 and WTA 1000 event runs August 13-23, a key US Open tune-up.
body: The 2026 Cincinnati Open, a combined ATP Masters 1000 and WTA 1000 tournament on outdoor hard courts, is set for August 13-23, giving the sport's top players a final big test before the US Open.
Draws and player lists are firming up as the North American hard-court swing builds toward the season's last major.

sports.h3: Eredivisie clubs race the clock before September 2 deadline
sports.summary: Ajax, PSV and Feyenoord reshape squads as the Dutch transfer window stays open until September 2.
body: The Eredivisie transfer window, open since June 22, runs until September 2, and the big three have been busy. PSV added midfielder Sven Mijnans and made goalkeeper Matej Kovar's move permanent, while Ismael Saibari left for Bayern Munich.

Feyenoord signed goalkeeper Tjark Ernst and striker Nacho Ferri, and Ajax saw Sean Steur depart for Newcastle. All three missed out on striker Alvaro Rodriguez, who chose Bournemouth for about 30 million euros.

sports.h3: ADCC trials and opens fill the early-August grappling calendar
sports.summary: Submission grappling ramps up with ADCC Austin and youth events as the road to the world championship continues.
body: The early-August grappling calendar is packed, with the ADCC Austin Open on August 9 and the ADCC Youth Championship on August 11 among the events keeping competitors active on the road toward ADCC's marquee championship.
Regional trials and opens continue to shape the qualification picture across weight classes.

sports.h3: WNBA names Cleveland expansion team the Sirens
sports.summary: The league's incoming Cleveland franchise will be called the Sirens and debut in 2028.
body: The WNBA announced that its expansion team in Cleveland will be called the Sirens, with the franchise set to debut in 2028 as the league continues its growth push.
The naming is the latest step in a wave of WNBA expansion amid rising attendance and media interest.

sports.h3: IBJJF Worlds champions crowned across every division
sports.summary: The season's biggest gi tournament produced a fresh set of division champions.
body: The 2026 IBJJF World Championship crowned champions across every division, refreshing the sport's pecking order ahead of the busy late-summer competition stretch.
The results feed into rankings and seedings that will shape the marquee events to come.

consumer-tech.h3: Google's Pixel 11 lineup lands August 12 in New York
consumer-tech.summary: Made by Google will unveil the Pixel 11, Pro, Pro XL and Pro Fold, plus the Pixel Watch 5, with prices starting at $899.
body: Google's Made by Google event on August 12 in New York is set to reveal the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, alongside the Pixel Watch 5. The base Pixel 11 is expected to start at $899 for 256GB, with the 128GB tier dropped.
Early commentary has been mixed, with reports suggesting the Pixel 11 lacks major hardware upgrades compared with last year's jump to Qi2 charging and a dedicated telephoto lens on the Pixel 10.

consumer-tech.h3: Apple readies a foldable iPhone for September
consumer-tech.summary: Reports say Apple is ordering components for its first foldable, to debut alongside the iPhone 18 Pro.
body: Apple is expected to debut its first foldable iPhone at its September event, with supply-chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo reporting component orders underway. The launch would mark Apple's entry into a category Samsung has long led.
Apple is also said to face supply pressures that could push up prices on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

consumer-tech.h3: Apple Car slips to 2028 with a scaled-back design
consumer-tech.summary: Apple has pushed its EV to a potential 2028 launch and dropped plans for a fully driverless vehicle.
body: Apple has set a potential 2028 release for its car, later than the once-rumoured 2026, and pivoted to a less ambitious, Tesla-like EV after abandoning plans for a completely driverless design.
The reset caps years of shifting ambitions for a project that has repeatedly changed scope and leadership.

consumer-tech.h3: Samsung leans on foldables to challenge Apple's cool factor
consumer-tech.summary: With the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Samsung is betting maturing foldables can blunt Apple's brand appeal.
body: Samsung is pressing its foldable lead with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 as Apple prepares its own folding phone, setting up a direct showdown in a category Samsung pioneered.
The company is also framing health and fitness, personalised by AI, as central to its device strategy.

consumer-tech.h3: AI-content labelling arrives for European users
consumer-tech.summary: New EU rules require flagging of mainly AI-generated content, changing how apps and platforms present media.
body: A new stage of the EU AI Act took effect August 2, requiring services that distribute mainly AI-generated content to label it, a change users across Europe will start to notice in feeds and media.
The rules push platforms toward clearer provenance signals as synthetic media proliferates.

consumer-tech.h3: Pixel Watch 5 and wearables share the Made by Google stage
consumer-tech.summary: Google's August event pairs new phones with refreshed wearables and accessories.
body: Alongside the Pixel 11 phones, Google is expected to introduce the Pixel Watch 5 and other accessories at its August 12 event, rounding out its hardware lineup ahead of the holiday season.
The wearables refresh continues Google's push to build a fuller device ecosystem around its Tensor silicon and AI features.

consumer-tech.h3: EV makers navigate a tariff-scrambled supply chain
consumer-tech.summary: Shifting US tariffs are reshaping where automakers and suppliers source components, adding cost pressure.
body: Automakers and EV suppliers are recalibrating sourcing as US tariffs shift, with some firms finding that duties raise costs without delivering the intended reshoring, a dynamic playing out across the wider manufacturing base.
The uncertainty complicates pricing and product timing for EVs already competing on thin margins.

consumer-tech.h3: Foldables move to center stage across the industry
consumer-tech.summary: With Apple, Samsung and Google all shipping or teasing folding phones, the form factor is going mainstream.
body: The second half of 2026 is shaping up as a foldable showdown, with Google's Pixel 11 Pro Fold, Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Apple's rumoured entrant all in play, signalling the form factor's move from niche to mainstream.
Buyers can expect more competition on price, durability and software optimised for larger folding displays.
